rows.question: An employee has worked here for six years. How many annual leave days do they get in total?
rows.answer: After five full years of service the allowance rises by 3 days [1]. Up to 6 unused days may be carried into the next year, but carried days expire on 31 March [1]. An employee who has worked for six years would receive 26 + 3 = 29 annual leave days in total [1].
